memo: PROMPT_COMMAND was set (step 9) but Ubuntu's default PS1 contains its own \e]0;\u@\h:\w\a title escape that RE-writes the title after PROMPT_COMMAND runs — that's why e9/e3 still read 'user@user-virtual-machine: ~'. Just stripped PS1 to '$ ', so the next prompt's title should become BATT=true. NEXT: read e9/e3. If BATT=true -> done (VM has no battery so no % appears in the System menu e87, but the setting is on). If false -> re-run gsettings set.
